title: Near By Deaths!
description: This mod only shows death messages within 500 blocks!
body:
**Welcome to Near By Deaths!**

with this plug-in you can see deaths messages only within 500 blocks of the death!
this mod also shows you exact cordinates of where the player died.


```
example:
steve was killed by alex at X- 100 Y- 50 Z- 100!
```
